description: This file defines a custom argument parser for user and group management commands, including functions for splitting command line parameters and building argument parsers for useradd and groupadd utilities. It also customizes error handling and message output for argument parsing.

classes.name: myArgumentParser
classes.description: A custom argparse.ArgumentParser subclass that overrides message printing, exit, and error handling, including warnings and fatal errors.

methods.name: _print_message(self, message, file=None)
methods.description: Overrides the default message printing to issue a warning via bb.warn with specific context.

methods.name: exit(self, status=0, message=None)
methods.description: Overrides the exit method to issue an error message instead of exiting normally.

methods.name: error(self, message)
methods.description: Overrides the error method to call bb.fatal, terminating execution on error.

methods.name: split_commands(params)
methods.description: Splits a string of command parameters separated by semicolons, respecting quoted substrings.

methods.name: split_args(params)
methods.description: Splits a string of command parameters separated by whitespace, respecting quoted substrings.

methods.name: build_useradd_parser()
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ArgumentParser configured for the useradd command, with relevant options.

methods.name: build_groupadd_parser()
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ArgumentParser configured for the groupadd command, with relevant options.
